mechanism_narrative: The sharp recovery in WORKPLACES mobility from t-2w to t-0w indicates more weekday circulation, which should lift retail visits within the next four weeks as commuting spillovers expand lunchtime and after-work shopping.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -59.9 at t-2w to -27.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC remains below its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days despite a continued increase in WORKPLACES mobility.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL mobility drops back from an elevated stay-at-home level, people spend less time at home and more time in out-of-home discretionary activities, which should raise RETAIL_REC within one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL falls below 15 points above baseline after being above 20 points in the prior week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 24.0 at t-2w to 13.6 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 14 days after RESIDENTIAL drops below the stated threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A joint improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals more commuting and denser weekday activity, and that interaction should translate into higher retail foot traffic over the following four weeks; the signal fails if only one of the two series improves.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -65.1 at t-2w to -50.4 at t-0w while WORKPLACES improved from -59.9 to -27.6
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to exceed its last-4-week mean even when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are higher than in the prior week for multiple consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: An upswing in GROCERY_PHARM indicates broader errand running and lower avoidance of indoor public places, which should spill over into retail-and-recreation mobility over the next one to two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM rises by at least 3 points week-on-week after a prior decline
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved from -24.3 at t-2w to -13.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM posts the stated week-on-week rise.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in PARKS mobility shifts discretionary outings toward outdoor recreation, and that substitution reduces retail-and-recreation mobility over the next four weeks because time spent in parks displaces shopping trips.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS increased from -38.4 at t-1w to -24.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last-4-week mean over the next 28 days while PARKS continues to increase or stays elevated.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains severely depressed relative to workplaces, retail activity will stay weak over the next four weeks because commuting-based customer flow is still missing; the mechanism is strongest when transit lags workplace recovery by more than about 20 points.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains more than 20 points below WORKPLACES for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -50.4 at t-0w while WORKPLACES was -27.6
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC improves over the next 28 days even though TRANSIT stays far below WORKPLACES by the stated margin.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained fall in RESIDENTIAL mobility combined with a rebound in TRANSIT indicates households are leaving home more often and making more discretionary trips, which should push RETAIL_REC higher within four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 24.0 at t-2w to 13.6 at t-0w while TRANSIT improved from -65.1 to -50.4
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days despite lower RESIDENTIAL mobility and higher TRANSIT mobility.

mechanism_narrative: A very sharp one-week drop in WORKPLACES signals a new constraint or demand shock that will spill into discretionary spending immediately, so RETAIL_REC should fall over the next week and remain weaker over the next month.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls by at least 10 points week-on-week after a recent recovery
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved to -27.6 at t-0w after being -46.6 at t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after the stated WORKPLACES drop.
